description: G1 Batch B retry: a play.entity_metadata packet (full packet bytes, hex) the RotN 3.3.4 test server sent for a player. Key 17 uses serializer type 14, which AquaAcrobatics 1.15.4 registers with vanilla DataSerializers.registerSerializer (PoseSerializer: an enum written as a VarInt ordinal). protodef does not know type 14, so the packet is dropped as a PartialReadError. No player identity in the bytes.
